reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are not something I see on most TikTok Shop magnesium, and $24.99 with an empty-box refund is a small bet for a before-bed scroll. I would try one box, not two.
objection: It is one form of magnesium, bisglycinate only, while other brands put 8 forms in one capsule. I also do not know if 2 capsules a night will do anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video where she has my exact problem (can't wind down, restless at night) and shows the box and the lab report. Without that, I scroll past.
